blurb: Guests can visit the tasting room and event space to enjoy a variety of kombucha flavors on draft and in bottles or cans, as well as local beers, wine, and craft cocktails. The brewery offers a farm to table food menu and hosts events. Their kombucha blends use local, homegrown, and organic ingredients with responsibly harvested wild plants and botanicals.
